description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractSubscriptions' that manages subscription data, including mappings between subscribers (Actors) and topics, filters, and topic data. It handles subscribing, unsubscribing, removing subscribers, and snapshotting the state, and utilizes abstract methods for topic hashing and lifecycle events related to topics.

classes.name: AbstractSubscriptions
classes.description: An abstract class representing subscription management, including subscriber-topic mappings, filters, and topic data, with abstract methods for topic hashing and lifecycle callbacks.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Adds or updates a subscriber's subscriptions to topics with an associated filter. Creates new topics if necessary and triggers lifecycle callbacks.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes specified topics from a subscriber's subscriptions and updates internal data structures accordingly.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber entirely from all subscription data.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks whether a subscriber is currently registered.

methods.name: countTopics
methods.description: Returns the total number of topics currently tracked.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates an immutable snapshot of the current subscription state.
